payload.title: Build the veteran-status cue on all seven tasks and answer with Laya
payload.description: Implement the veteran-status insertion cue (iraq / navy / floor clauses, same eligibility and insertion rule as batch-1 cues) and build versions files for all seven Bias in Bios tasks. Answer with the upstream Laya engine (free) on all seven tasks and score against the floor per docs/veteran-status-preregistration.md, Design A.
